consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1970-09-20 show at Fillmore East features an outstanding performance, particularly highlighting the acoustic set and the energy of the electric set. Despite some criticisms regarding sound quality, many reviewers express that the music itself is exceptional and worth listening to.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.5 for 141 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While the performance is highly praised, the sound quality issues lead to a more tempered overall sentiment.
